Name: Axolotl over Purple Turtle
Author: TheGreatHen
Description:
This mod replaces the purple turtle sprites with a cute axolotl. Comes in a variety of different colors ranging from[b] Pink, Blue, Blue and Pink[/b] and [b]Brown[/b].

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher

[/url][b]How to use:﻿
[/b]- Unzip the file and move it to the SMAPI mods folder
- Pink is the base color. If you want to change the color, delete the previous sprite and copy the png file from it's color folder into the Animals folder.
